say: Goods in, without the paper tally sheet.
Meet LPN Pallet Log. It runs right in your phone's browser.
Scan or type each LPN, and tap the pallet type. It stays selected for the next one.
Live totals count every type, and show how many pallets are still to come.
Then check the delivery against the manifest. Missing pallets to report, extras to book in.
Export the log to Excel or PDF, ready to print or email.
It works offline, needs no account, and saves as you go. LPN Pallet Log.
